text: …やどらーん　ってば　わたしの　いうこと　きいて！

structure.jp: わたしの　いうこと

patterns.name: 〜ってば
patterns.span: やどらーん　ってば
patterns.explanation: ってば after a name shows the speaker is fed up that the person is not listening. やどらーん　ってば = 'Slowbrooo, come on!'

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A て form on its own at the end is a casual request, with ください left off. きいて = 'listen'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わたしの　いうこと
patterns.explanation: A verb right before a thing describes that thing, and の here shows who does the saying. わたしの　いうこと = 'the things I say'.
